answer: Charge every agent identity a flat demurrage fee each epoch, deducted from its locked stake whether it works or not. A real agent covers this small toll with client earnings, so its balance shows a positive delta over time. A sybil farm of 300 idle clones pays the fee 300 times while earning almost nothing, and each clone's stake slowly freezes into a tundra of losses. Every deduction is inked on the public ledger like a quill stroke, so draining shells are easy to spot and prune.
